data.description:
## Problem
`make worktree name=<branch>` creates the branch/worktree, but if its delegated `make venv && make install` step fails, the recipe continues, prints “✓ worktree ready,” and exits 0.

Observed when ambient `uv 0.12.9` violated the repository's `==0.12.7` pin: `make venv` failed and no `.venv` existed, yet the target reported success.

## Expected
The target exits nonzero on any provisioning failure and does not print the success message.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A provisioning failure makes `make worktree` exit nonzero.
- [ ] The success message is printed only after provisioning succeeds.
- [ ] A regression test covers the failure path without leaving a worktree or branch behind.
data.title: make worktree reports success after provisioning failure
